title: Narrow child envelopes without silent parent inheritance
narrative: Delegated work gets an explicit capability envelope. Children must not inherit the parent's full grants, and widening must fail. Accepts inspiration requirement 7[^insp-r07]. Child attenuation for Dots MH-DOTS-01; execution token fields: `fangore_insp_execution_token`[^insp-dots-01-env].
implementation: `CapabilityEnvelope.narrow` and `DefaultDelegationPolicy` choose inline versus child execution.
validation: Kind `capability_envelope_narrow`. Soft expects narrow ok, widen raises, child delegation.
